front_on.description: Bowler / Umpire perspective facing the batsman directly. Ideal for head lateral fall, bat swing line towards extra cover, shoulder alignment, and front foot placement.

side_on.description: Profile perspective from point/covers or square leg. Ideal for front knee bend angle, backlift apex height, and stride extension along the crease.

cover_drive.name: Cover Drive
cover_drive.description: Classic attacking off-side drive through extra cover, requiring leaning head, high front elbow, front foot to the pitch of the ball, and flowing follow-through.

footwork.label: Stride to the Pitch of the Ball

timing.label: Bat Speed Peak at Ball Contact

bat_swing_path.label: Swing Arc through Extra Cover Line

straight_drive.name: Straight Drive
straight_drive.description: Drive executed back past the bowler with full face of the bat, vertical swing path, and head directly over the contact point.

pull_shot.name: Pull Shot
pull_shot.description: Cross-bat aggressive shot to short-pitched bowling, transferring weight back and rotating hips/shoulders through midwicket.

cut_shot.name: Square Cut
cut_shot.description: Back-foot horizontal bat shot played square of the wicket through point, requiring high hands and rapid wrist snap down on the ball.

forward_defense.name: Forward Defense
forward_defense.description: Solid defensive block with soft hands, bat angled down towards the pitch, head close to ball, and bat tucked tightly beside front pad.
